conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Granular Sorting
style.description: A bright kitchen-lab: a clear, straight-sided, flat-fronted glass jar one bead layer deep, clamped to the aluminium platform of a small white lab shaker on a pale stone counter in front of a sage tiled wall, filled with small cream beads and twelve large glossy red ones mixed at every height. Each tap of the platform lifts and loosens the bed; small beads fall into the gaps that open under the large ones, so the large ones ratchet up and end on top. Bead positions come from a seeded Monte Carlo tap-and-settle simulation run once at load (shaker.js); the hop between stored rest states is drawn.
motion: One tap per shake: the platform rises and falls (raised cosine); the bed rides up, loosens (higher beads rise more), then falls back lowest first into the next simulated rest state.
Rest states come from a seeded Monte Carlo tap-and-settle simulation (shaker.js): lift + loosen, then down-or-sideways random moves with no overlaps, lowest bead first.
Small beads fill the gaps that open under large ones; large ones rarely find a gap their size, so they ratchet up a step per tap.
Fast forward strobes the rest states: one quick step per tap, accelerating; red trails draw each large bead's path.
The plate stops on the first tap after which all twelve red beads stay uncovered.

notes.mechanism: shaker.js: Monte Carlo tap-and-settle (lift 2 + 0.2 x height, then 40 lowest-first passes of down-or-sideways hard-disc moves). 2D: one bead layer; cream depth jitter is look only.
notes.run: 492 beads (12 red), 64 taps simulated; shown: 47 (all twelve uncovered from tap 47); focus bead 3 rises 6.4 radii over taps 6-9 with 5 cream arrivals beneath
